echo_sets.name: Sierra Gale
echo_sets.note: The Aero DPS set; Nightmare: Feilian Beringal grants Aero DMG and Heavy Attack DMG buffs, which are Jiyan's two main damage scalings.

echo_sets.name: Sierra Gale (2-pc) + Lingering Tunes (2-pc)
echo_sets.note: Mix for extra ATK% while keeping Aero DMG bonus; use while farming a full Sierra Gale set.

build.energy_regen_target: 130% minimum (Liberation uptime is his whole damage budget)
build.fast_path: Fast path: Verdant Summit (or Thunderflare Dominion / Autumntrace) + 5-piece Sierra Gale in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Nightmare: Feilian Beringal in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Aero DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and at least 130% Energy Regen to keep Qingloong Mode uptime high.

ranked_weapons.name: Verdant Summit
ranked_weapons.note: His signature; Crit DMG substat plus stacking Heavy Attack DMG Bonus on Intro/Liberation. Easily best in slot.

ranked_weapons.name: Thunderflare Dominion
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% with Heavy Attack DMG Bonus on Intro/Resonance Skill; solid limited 5-star alternative.

ranked_weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
ranked_weapons.note: Standard 5-star; ATK% and Liberation DMG bonuses; easy to obtain.

ranked_weapons.name: Aureate Zenith
ranked_weapons.note: BP 4-star; ATK% and Heavy Attack DMG Bonus on Liberation. Strong F2P pick.

ranked_weapons.name: Autumntrace
ranked_weapons.note: Craftable 4-star; Crit Rate substat with stacking ATK% on Basic/Heavy hits.

stat_priorities.note: Crit 4-cost; balance toward a ~70:250 Crit ratio.
Aero DMG on both; ATK% is a serviceable substitute.

profile.role_note: Qingloong Mode hypercarry; deals the bulk of his damage through empowered Heavy Attacks during Liberation.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: The original limited Aero hypercarry. Still usable in Tower of Adversity and Matrix if you already own him, but don't count on him for Whimpering Wastes anymore — newer DPS leave him behind.

members.name: Jiyan
members.note: Qingloong Mode carry; Liberation then Heavy Attack chains for AoE nukes.

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Premier Heavy Attack DMG buffer; huge amplification for Jiyan's Qingloong Mode plus her own damage and healing.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: General team-wide damage buffs, Crit boosts, and sustain with minimal field time.

teams.name: Premium: Jiyan + Iuno + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm, Iuno runs her buff window and Outros into Jiyan for the Heavy Attack amplification, then Jiyan casts Liberation and stays on field for Qingloong Mode chains.

members.name: Jiyan
members.note: Same Qingloong Mode carry; benefits from Mortefi's Heavy Attack Outro buff.

members.name: Mortefi
members.note: Best 4-star partner for Jiyan; Outro Skill grants Heavy Attack DMG amplification.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Healing, ATK buffs, and All-Type DMG Deepen on Outro; the classic Jiyan partner since launch.

teams.name: Alternative: Jiyan + Mortefi + Verina
teams.rotation: Verina buffs and heals, Mortefi drops his Liberation for the Outro Heavy Attack buff, then Jiyan takes the field for his Qingloong Mode rotation.

tier_badge.label: Top tier
tier_badge.note: S overall on the Game8 3.7 tier list (S+ in Tower of Adversity as of the Oct 12 update); best-in-class WhiWa AoE clearer.

sequences.verdict: S0 is fully endgame-viable. S3 is the first real power spike and the stop point; S6 only for whales.

pull_path.why: Full Qingloong Mode hypercarry; S0 clears all content.
+30 Resolve on Intro plus +28% ATK smooths setups and unlocks Finale fast.
+16% Crit Rate and +32% Crit DMG on key skills; patches his Crit needs.
Momentum stacks turn Emerald Storm: Finale into a massive nuke.

nodes.name: Benevolence
nodes.effect: Windqueller gains an extra charge and its Resolve cost drops by 15.

nodes.name: Versatility
nodes.effect: Intro Tactical Strike grants 30 Resolve and +28% ATK for 15s (once per 15s).

nodes.name: Spectation
nodes.effect: Casting Windqueller, Prelude, Finale, or Intro grants +16% Crit Rate and +32% Crit DMG for 8s.

nodes.name: Prudence
nodes.effect: Casting Prelude or Finale grants all team members +25% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus for 30s.

nodes.name: Resolution
nodes.effect: Outro Discipline DMG multiplier +120%; ATK +3% per hit up to 15 stacks, instantly maxed on Intro.

nodes.name: Fortitude
nodes.effect: Heavy Attack/Intro/Windqueller grant Momentum (max 2); Finale consumes stacks for +120% DMG multiplier each.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Verdant Summit before S2 - both early nodes are minor; S3 is the only dupe worth chasing instead.
